g.text: GameState stores live domain references; Snapshot carries copied view records, not live objects.
Black diamonds = internally created lifetime-owned parts (two Tables in the base setting).
Record fields are private/final; generated accessors are public. List values are copied defensively.
GameConfig, Snapshot, Action, ActionResult and TurnEnd are Java records. Underlined members are static.
GameState shows its key operations; routine accessors are omitted.
Queue/Table/Menu/Customer/Order boxes refer to the domain view; Customer is abstract.
TurnStart, TurnSummary, GameEvent and the three *View records are supporting return values.
